newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: QUF says expects some profit recovery.
newsitem.headline: QUF says expects some profit recovery.

text.p: Dairy foods group QUF Industries Ltd said on Wednesday that it expected some recovery in net profit in the year to June 30, 1997.

"On the basis of present plans and trading in the first months of the current year, directors expect that there should be some recovery in the next profit after tax from ongoing operations in the coming year," QUF said in a statement accompanying its 1995/96 results.
The company said earlier that profit in the 1996/96 fell to A$11.51 million from A$15.01 million despite a rise in sales by 4.3 percent to A$585.04 million.

"The major factors adversely affecting the results were substantial competitive activity in the deregulated Victorian liquid milk market and significan increases in raw materials and packaging costs in the Northern Territory," QUF said.
The company said that in Victoria, action has been taken to reduce operating costs while price increases achieved late in the financial year will assist margins.
